when.tl: Kung ikaw o ibang tao ay nasa agarang panganib, o para ipa-verify sa pulis ang kahina-hinalang parcel o account.
when.en: If you or someone else is in immediate danger, or to have a suspicious parcel or account checked by police.

name.tl: CICC National Anti-Scam Hotline 1326 (Inter-Agency Response Center)
name.en: CICC National Anti-Scam Hotline 1326 (Inter-Agency Response Center)

when.tl: Para i-report ang anumang scam na text, tawag, link o online na panloloko, kahit hindi ka nawalan ng pera.
when.en: To report any scam text, call, link or online fraud, even if you did not lose money.

when.tl: Kung nawalan ka ng pera o na-hack ang account mo, para magsampa ng reklamo sa pulis tungkol sa cybercrime.
when.en: If you lost money or your account was taken over, to file a cybercrime complaint with the police.

when.tl: Agad-agad kung nagpadala ka ng pera o nagbigay ng password, MPIN, OTP o detalye ng card: hilingin na i-block ang account at pigilan o i-trace ang transfer.
when.en: Straight away if you sent money or shared a password, MPIN, OTP or card details: ask them to block the account and stop or trace the transfer.

label.tl: Ang hotline sa likod ng card mo, o ang help center sa loob ng app ng bangko o e-wallet mo
label.en: The hotline on the back of your card, or the help centre inside your bank or e-wallet app

when.tl: Kung GCash ang ginamit sa scam: i-report ito at i-lock ang account mo mula sa app.
when.en: If the scam involved GCash: report it and lock your account from the app.

name.tl: Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas: BSP Online Buddy (BOB)
name.en: Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas: BSP Online Buddy (BOB)

when.tl: Kung hindi inayos ng bangko o e-wallet mo ang reklamo mo. Isama ang reklamo mo sa kanila at ang sagot nila.
when.en: If your bank or e-wallet did not resolve your complaint. Attach your complaint to them and their reply.

name.tl: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Enforcement and Investor Protection Department
name.en: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Enforcement and Investor Protection Department

when.tl: Para alamin kung rehistrado ang isang investment, o para i-report ang investment scam.
when.en: To check whether an investment offer is registered, or to report an investment scam.

name.tl: DSWD (Department of Social Welfare and Development)
name.en: DSWD (Department of Social Welfare and Development)

when.tl: Para i-verify ang mensahe tungkol sa ayuda (AICS, 4Ps): magtanong sa DSWD field office o sa local social welfare office.
when.en: To check a message about cash aid (ayuda, AICS, 4Ps): ask your DSWD field office or local social welfare office.
